summary: Only candidate that satisfies every constraint: OIDC trusted publishing with SLSA provenance, zero dependencies, bundled types, active maintenance, and not affected by CVE-2026-93753. Also the fastest in the benchmark.
reasoning: Publishing is fully CI-driven: workflow_dispatch invokes the Fastify org reusable release workflow, which runs in a protected release environment and publishes with npm publish --provenance --access public over OIDC. No long-lived NPM_TOKEN exists to leak.
The npm attestation resolves to builder github-hosted, source repo fastify/deepmerge and workflow .github/workflows/release.yml, tying the tarball to a commit.
Zero runtime dependencies and a 36 KB install, the smallest of the maintained candidates.
Verified safe against all four CVE-2026-93753 bypass variants, including null-prototype targets and null placeholders.
3.2.4 released 2026-10-22 with 0 open issues and 0 open PRs; CI enforces 100% line coverage.
Measured ~860k merges per second on our nested-config workload, roughly 8x deepmerge.
caveats: Does not detect cycles; circular input causes a stack overflow. Use deepmerge-ts if cyclic graphs are possible.
Arrays concatenate by default; configure mergeArray to replace instead.
Single npm maintainer (eomm). Org ownership, a small code surface and 100% coverage mitigate this, but the bus factor is still one.
CommonJS entry only. Default imports work from ESM via interop; there are no named ESM exports.

evidence.label: CI publish pipeline
evidence.detail: workflow_dispatch -> fastify/workflows reusable-release.yml, protected release environment, npm publish --provenance --access public, actions pinned to commit SHAs, no NPM_TOKEN.

evidence.label: SLSA provenance
evidence.detail: SLSA v1 attestation for 3.2.4: builder actions/runner/github-hosted, source fastify/deepmerge, workflow .github/workflows/release.yml, ref refs/heads/main.

evidence.label: CVE-2026-93753
evidence.detail: Reproduced variants 1-4 against 3.2.4; all blocked. OSV package query returns no advisories.

evidence.label: Dependency footprint
evidence.detail: 0 runtime dependencies, 1 installed package, 36 KB install / 21 KB unpacked.

evidence.label: Maintenance
evidence.detail: 3.2.4 published 2026-10-22; 0 open issues; 0 open PRs; release workflow active.

evidence.label: TypeScript types
evidence.detail: Bundled types/index.d.ts. Strict-mode probe preserves optionality and readonly; conflicting scalars resolve to the right-hand type.

evidence.label: Runtime behaviour
evidence.detail: ~860k ops/s. No cycle support. Arrays concat by default. undefined overwrites unless onlyDefinedProperties is set.
